column1: # Experimental / opt-in userspace components for the zorn profile.
# These are NOT first-class manifest projects and are NOT installed into the
# default image. They are tracked here so the rootfs profile has a single,
# reviewable record of the experimental layers a user can opt into on top of
# the shipped Arch userspace. install-meowarch.sh does not consume this file;
# it is documentation/policy only (unlike components.lock.tsv, which records
# the runtime subsystem repositories the installer expects).

column4: experimental Android-like mobile shell (launcher/statusbar/gestures/keys); opt-in, not in the default image
